sourceHelp: Choose cash already withdrawn or returned to the till. This lookup does not reserve it; the server checks again on confirmation.
none: No eligible movements on this page.
notBank: Records cash already moved. Does not transfer funds, execute Pix/cards or confirm bank settlement.
pendingHelp: The original attempt is saved on this computer. Check the result before retrying. Do not make another physical payment.
retryConfirm: Resend the exact original operation? This must not involve another physical payment.
discardConfirm: Discard this attempt after checking it is absent? Uncertain results will not be discarded.
missing: Record not found yet. This does not prove failure: check again or retry the same operation.
discarded: Attempt discarded after checking. No cash was moved.
storage: Unable to check the saved attempt. New writes are blocked on this computer.
locks: This browser cannot coordinate writes across tabs. Read access remains available.
locked: Another tab is using this operation. Wait and check again.
readonly: Read access is available. Writes require till permission and an active subscription.
unavailable: Unable to retrieve or confirm. Check your connection and server version.
invalid: Data does not match expectations. Refresh the document and check again.
conflict: The movement or balance changed. Check the attempt result before choosing another.
denied: You do not have permission for this operation.
range: The lookup safety limit was reached. No partial result was shown.
stale: The lookup is too old. Refresh and select again before confirming.
future: Document creation and approval, electronic payments and goods receipt remain separate from this flow.
document_not_approved: This document is not approved for applying payments.
installment_fully_applied: This installment is already fully applied.
payment_history_limit: This document reached its historical record limit.
historical_amount_limit: This document reached its cumulative amount limit.
payment_already_returned: This payment was already fully returned.
sourceContext: Only eligible movements belonging to your user on this device and store.
noReservation: Selecting a movement does not reserve the cash.
localPending: Attempt saved only on this computer, scoped to company, store, device and user. No password or token. Preserved after sign-out for recovery.
leave: There are unsent fields or a confirmation in progress. Leave?
noSnapshot: Check balances before recording a link.
